name: Nether
author: veilios
description:
Obsidian vault notes in your Omarchy bar. Read, edit, search, and manage Markdown notes without leaving your desktop.

Features
Bar widget — Open your notes from the bar panel
Full Markdown rendering — Headers, lists, code, blockquotes, tables, tasks
Vault folder navigation — Create, move, and organize notes
Search — Fuzzy search note names and content (Ctrl+S)
Auto-save — Edits persist instantly; read-only on switch
Keyboard support — mostly navigable with just the keyboard, as dhh intended

barWidget.description: Read and edit notes from your Obsidian vault in a bar panel. Remembers the last open note, autosaves edits, resets to read-only on note switch.
